title: A surjection with finitely presented kernel and target has finitely presented source
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, let $M,P$ be $R$-modules, and let $v:M\to P$ be a surjective $R$-linear map. Put $K=\ker(v)=\{m\in M:v(m)=0\}$ with its induced $R$-module structure. If $K$ and $P$ are finitely presented $R$-modules [def-sc-finitely-presented-module], then $M$ is a finitely presented $R$-module.
